annotations.title: Change where a QR code goes

description: Changes the web address a dynamic link QR code in the signed-in qrforprint account forwards to. Printed copies keep working and open the new address from the next scan. Accepts the code ID or its short link. Static codes, disabled codes and photo, PDF or voice note codes cannot be changed with this tool.

code.description: The code ID or its short link, as shown by list_my_codes.

destination_url.description: The new web address, starting with http:// or https://.

name: update_code_destination
